purpose: Adversarial acceptance cases; not executable production proof
fixture_policy: synthetic only; no customer data, charges, production mutations or paid provider calls

scenarios.action: Create valid session and project
scenarios.expected: Project exists only in A; B cannot see it

scenarios.action: Revoke session during recovery and retry
scenarios.expected: Old token denied; new authenticated context required

scenarios.action: Read tenant A project/run via direct ID
scenarios.expected: 403/404; no data or existence leak

scenarios.action: Create five approved buyer questions
scenarios.expected: Question versions and ownership persisted

scenarios.action: Mutate tenant A question via direct ID
scenarios.expected: Denied and unchanged

scenarios.action: Run authorized provider capture within budget
scenarios.expected: Actual provider/model/response/usage receipt and context retained

scenarios.action: Return unrelated polysemous search result
scenarios.expected: Relevance fail closed, insufficient evidence not zero visibility

scenarios.action: Provider yields partial/refused/timeout result
scenarios.expected: Explicit partial/error state; no fabricated recommendation

scenarios.action: Attempt provider identity substitution
scenarios.expected: Provider/model identity unverified; comparable cycle blocked

scenarios.action: Exceed cost reservation or provider spend cap
scenarios.expected: Admission rejected before paid call

scenarios.action: Inspect genuine raw answer and returned source
scenarios.expected: Native references vs retrieved content vs inference distinguished

scenarios.action: Review tenant A source via direct ID
scenarios.expected: Denied; no cross-project leak

scenarios.action: Approve evidence and persist Change Specification
scenarios.expected: Decision state/owner/version/audit record survive reload

scenarios.action: Attempt protected decision mutation
scenarios.expected: Role denied; no persistence

scenarios.action: Disconnect during run and retry same idempotency key
scenarios.expected: One operation/accounting event; durable recoverable state

scenarios.action: Request second cycle with changed model/context
scenarios.expected: Not comparable; no uplift claim

scenarios.action: Request eligible reviewed later cycle matching matrix
scenarios.expected: Comparable only with actual later observation and review

scenarios.action: Advance fixture clock without actual elapsed customer activity
scenarios.expected: Fixture never counted as real retention

scenarios.action: Export authorized reviewed project evidence
scenarios.expected: Only A/project records with provenance and limits

scenarios.action: Export tenant A object via ID
scenarios.expected: Denied; no secret or record exposure

scenarios.action: Use sandbox successful checkout and verified event
scenarios.expected: Entitlement from authoritative verified receipt only

scenarios.action: Submit forged/unverified webhook
scenarios.expected: Signature/origin/admission denied; no entitlement

scenarios.action: Replay out-of-order and duplicate verified events
scenarios.expected: Exactly-once durable event transition; no resurrection of stale entitlement

scenarios.action: Cancel, fail payment, retry, recover
scenarios.expected: State reconciled; no unauthorized paid feature access

scenarios.action: Access tenant A billing portal or entitlements
scenarios.expected: Denied; account scope enforced

scenarios.action: Run scheduled job after auth/credential revocation
scenarios.expected: No unsafe retry/spend; explicit operator diagnostic

scenarios.action: Complete CTA, login, question and review controls
scenarios.expected: Visible focus, labels, dialogs and error announcements

scenarios.action: Test 320/375/768/1024/1440 viewport widths
scenarios.expected: No critical overflow, blocking sticky CTA or inaccessible controls

scenarios.action: Try merge PR when security check intentionally fails
scenarios.expected: Blocked without bypass; documented emergency review required

scenarios.action: Rehearse previous verified release after failure
scenarios.expected: Recover version+schema-compatible state; verify exact SHA

scenarios.action: Switch active project or navigate from authorized Record A to unrelated Record B without remount while Record B authorization request is pending
scenarios.expected: Share/export/decision actions fail closed immediately and remain unavailable until the new record plus project identity is verified; server denies direct ID

scenarios.action: Export Recommendation Record whose untrusted answer/reference/question text begins with spreadsheet formula markers, tabs, control characters or double quotes
scenarios.expected: CSV formula injection neutralized; quoting and evidence provenance retained; unknown method/model/version not fabricated
